jamie_cs: Quick weekly check-in for OnboardCo — noticed a jump in error signals this morning, want to sync before renewal convo next week. Top-level: 5xx spike, more timeouts, small uptick in rate-limits.
alex_infra: seeing the same in infra metrics, rolling 1h view: 5xx = 3.4% (was 0.9% last week), timeouts = 1.8% (0.4%), rate_limit = 0.6% (0.2%). Root of spike concentrated on a few endpoints. :eyes:
alex_infra: top failing endpoints (last 24h):
- `/v1/generate` 5xx 4.9% / timeout 2.1%
- `/v1/chat/stream` 5xx 3.8% / timeout 1.7%
- `/v1/embeddings/batch` 5xx 2.9% / rate_limit 1.4%
- `/v1/uploads` timeout 3.0% (backoff hitting client-side)
jamie_cs: thanks — onboarding usage has dropped ~22% this week which raises renewal risk. They run nightly bulk embeddings job to index new docs — might explain `/v1/embeddings/batch` pressure.
maria_se: I looked at recent deploys — we rolled a small quantized variant to canary yesterday for perf tests. Latency distribution bumped for longer seqs, and the runtime's kernel selection might be hitting a path that fails under specific sequence lengths. I'll pin canary and re-run perf.
alex_infra: good call. Imo immediate action: 1) pin model variant to previous stable for OnboardCo traffic, 2) increase short-term concurrency on the Dedicated pool by +2 GPUs (temp burst), 3) enable more aggressive K/V cache for chat routes.
jamie_cs: agree. Also planning enablement doc for their ops team to stagger batch jobs. Leo, can you coordinate? @leo_csm
leo_csm: on it — will ask them to shift nightly index to off-peak and throttle batch size to 250 per request. I’ll send an email with recommended roll-forward plan and renewal touch points.
opsbot: [alert-summary] OnboardCo — 5xx spike detected 2026-03-18T09:12Z -> alert_id: A-9871, current status: investigating, affected_pools: dedicated-us-east-1.
alex_infra: quick troubleshooting snippet I ran:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input": "lorem..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# got 502 with backend timeout, trace id: trace-0a1b2c
```
maria_se: extracted a small stack of failing traces — consistent OOM in canary model when sequence > 8k tokens. Rolling back should clear most 5xxs.
jamie_cs: action items summarized: 1) maria -> pin canary rollback (in 10m), 2) alex -> provision +2 GPUs to Dedicated burst and enable KV cache on chat, 3) leo -> customer coordination + schedule batch shift, 4) jamie -> monitor weekly health and update renewal risk if issues persist.
leo_csm: I'll also attach a 1-pager showing error trends for their executive renewal packet.
alex_infra: I'll post updated metrics here in 30m. If anyone wants immediate dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/OnboardCo-errors
jamie_cs: perfect — thanks team. Will reconvene tomorrow AM if rates aren't back under threshold (5xx < 1%). :thumbsup:
